notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Salvager of Secrets.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Repeat.
